recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized, illustrative mugshot of a bearded man wearing a beanie and a collared shirt, set against a height-marker background. The entire image uses a heavy CMYK-style halftone dot pattern and distressed paper texture to mimic vintage newspaper or comic book printing.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against horizontal height lines
Text-heavy placard held at chest level
Numerical height markers flanking the subject symmetrically
Heavy vignette framing the square composition
coreInvariants: Visible halftone dot screen across all elements
Muted, desaturated color palette with yellow-tan base
Distressed, burnt edges and paper grain
Thick, dark ink-like outlines on the character

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central bust-up portrait, filling approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, rectangular placard held at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, moves down to the placard text, then outward to the height numbers on the sides.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with horizontal lines and numerical data.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm tan and beige (background and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (outlines, beanie, and placard)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow and muted red (text and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast between dark ink lines and light paper background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to a four-color process feel

letterConstructionRules: Slightly rounded corners due to ink-bleed effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers on the background use a stencil-like or mechanical stamp aesthetic
Placard text features a subtle inner glow or outline
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold display sans-serif for the name paired with mechanical, stamped numerals for the height chart.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky presence for the placard.
Matches the mechanical, tall feel of the height markers.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a stylized illustration of a man with a beard and beanie in a mugshot pose, holding a blank black rectangular placard. The background should be a tan-colored wall with horizontal lines and height numbers (140 to 180) on the sides. Apply a heavy CMYK halftone dot filter and distressed paper texture with dark vignette edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase yellow sans-serif text onto the black placard. Add a four-digit number in a dark stamped font above the placard on the shirt area. Ensure all text inherits the halftone dot texture of the underlying image.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern consistent across text and image?
Are the height numbers aligned with the horizontal lines?
Is the color palette restricted to warm, muted tones?
Does the text look like it was printed with ink on the placard?

mustRedesign: Unique logos on the shirt or placard
Exact facial likeness of a specific person
postGenerationChecks: Check for moiré patterns in the halftone
Ensure the vignette doesn't obscure the height numbers
Verify the text appears integrated into the texture
Confirm the 'mugshot' theme is immediately recognizable
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central character portrait with a structured, data-driven background (like a height chart) and unify the composition using a singular, aggressive print-texture filter like halftone dots.
